en: A black-and-white illustrated postcard depicting an ancient stone gate and surrounding buildings, with people gathered and walking in a lively square. The architecture is Romanesque, and the scene features a central arched gateway, known as 'Porta ferrea,' with several smaller structures and a columned kiosk in the foreground. The text at the bottom is in both Italian and Croatian, indicating the name of the city and the monument.
